name: Orbit — Portfolio & related articles
description: Public HQ: Blog MDX in git, portfolio proof, curated Related articles RSS, and Studio JSON edits. Weekly Write drafts can generate; Slack Approve is the publish gate.

name: Nordic Equity Heatmap
description: TradingView-style sector board for Nordic large-caps (size = market cap, color = day change %). Lives with the Nordic Equity report in powerbi-portfolio/01-finance — PBIP pages plus this Vite board on Vercel.

name: ProjectBrain
description: Portfolio memory for Cursor agents: local SQLite + vectors + graph, MCP session handoff, winner playbooks, risk/momentum scoring. IDE-only; cloud automations stay on repo state.

name: Power BI — Nordic Boardroom
description: Shared report grammar: gold tables → semantic model → Landing / Pulse / Drivers / Queue / Context, then PNG sync into Orbit. Import-shaped demos on purpose; screenshots match the repo.

name: Ledger — strategy research cycle
description: Compare equity strategy families on one sample, switch the working rule only when Sharpe clears ~0.08, then list exits/adds/trims with reasons. I still click the trades; no broker automation.

name: mealplan
description: Slack-triggered week plan from YAML defaults (overrides in the kickoff message): plate guidance, multi-store grocery split, phone-readable channel post. No checkout; one shared menu.

name: Personal ops coach (git + Slack)
description: Science-backed personal coach: Intervals form + Slack RPE → AthleteState → Sunday week plan. Arc Mode adds gate ranks (STR/AGI/SPD/END/VIT/PER), weekly quests, and Red Gate audits on the same deterministic rules.
